title: Betaab
description: Sunny Deol and his childhood friend Roma Amrita Singh fall in love with each other. But Roma's father Shammi Kapoor disapproves of their union and decides to separate them.

title: Dhoom 3
description: A circus performer turns to crime to avenge his father's humiliation, facing off against a relentless cop. High-octane stunts, emotion, and revenge collide in this stylish action thriller.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
description: A psychiatrist unravels strange events in an ancestral mansion haunted by secrets. As science clashes with superstition, a shocking truth emerges in this gripping psychological horror-comedy.

title: Padmaavat
description: Padmavati is happily married to a Rajput ruler until a tyrant Sultan, Alauddin Khilji, enters their life and calls a war on their kingdom.

title: Andhadhun
description: An inspiring tale unfolds where faith and destiny collide, testing hearts and guiding souls toward truth, sacrifice, and the eternal light of divine blessings.

title: Drishyam
description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

title: Parole
description: After their mother's untimely demise, two estranged brothers who hate each other must reunite to perform her final rites.

title: Guru
description: Aditya, a boxer, sees potential in a vegetable vendor, Rameshwari, and decides to train her. However, the two do not get along due to the former's harsh training style and the latter's hostile nature.

title: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex
description: Binita relocates to Navi Mumbai with her daughter Navya after a divorce. New friendships lead them into the exciting and unpredictable world of stock market investing.

title: Dhoom
description: A fearless cop and a biker thief engage in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase through high-speed robberies. The stylish action film redefined Bollywood's love for speed, style, and attitude.

title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
description: Dev and Maya, both unhappy in their marriages, become friends and support each other. While trying to fix their relationships, they unexpectedly fall in love, complicating their lives.

title: Om Shanti Om
description: A junior artiste in Bollywood films is reborn as a superstar. He exposes the murder of his love, a yesteryears' superstar.

title: Kaabil
description: This is the story of a blind couple who lived, laughed and loved just like everyone in this world. Until one day, a terrible tragedy struck.

title: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
description: Sanjay and Anjali secretly love each other, but Anjali's engagement to Rohit traps them. They must confront their true feelings before it's too late.
